remarks:
Freshly renovated home in an established neighborhood with classic charm and modern updates. Welcome to 111 Duerstein Street, a 3-bedroom, 2-bath home featuring extensive improvements throughout, including newly installed hardwood floors, new drywall, light fixtures, insulation, HVAC, hot water tank, and 100-amp electrical service. The roof was installed in 2024.

The bright, sunny living room offers plenty of natural light, while the decorative fireplace adds character and charm. The kitchen includes a comfortable eat-in nook, and the formal dining room provides additional space for meals and entertaining.

Each bedroom features new wood flooring, freshly painted walls, and functional closet space. An additional attic storage area is accessible through a door above the second-floor stairs. Both full bathrooms feature sliding glass shower doors and extensive tile work, offering easy maintenance while adding a stylish, polished look.

A first-floor laundry adds everyday convenience. The freshly painted full basement offers additional storage and workspace and features exterior-only access through newly poured concrete steps. The long driveway provides ample off-street parking.

Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, parks, major roadways, public transportation, West Seneca, and South Buffalo. A great opportunity to enjoy a freshly renovated home while maintaining the charm of an established neighborhood. Seller is open to offers and will thoughtfully review them as they are received.
